title: Aya 101 Public Launch
summary: Cohere For AI announced the public launch of Aya on February 13, 2024. The accompanying primary technical paper describes Aya as an instruction-following multilingual generative language model covering 101 languages and states that the model and instruction datasets were released openly for research use.
significance: A dated public-release milestone for an openly released multilingual language model designed to extend instruction-following coverage across 101 languages, including many lower-resourced languages.

verification.note: Cohere For AI's first-party launch announcement is dated February 13, 2024 and explicitly announces Aya. The authors' primary technical paper, submitted February 12, 2024, documents Aya as an instruction-following multilingual generative language model covering 101 languages and states that the instruction datasets and model were openly released. This candidate records the February 13 public-launch milestone only; it does not treat the February 12 paper-submission date as the model's birth date and does not infer development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.
